tracks.name: Track 1 – Creative
tracks.who: Designers, product and project managers, and others with little or no coding experience. The job is deciding what the experience should be and directing the tools that build it.

titles.title: Product Manager
titles.why: Frames problems and sets evidence; not an implementation role

titles.title: Project / Program Manager
titles.why: Plans and coordinates delivery; a general title, many are outside software and design

titles.title: Product Designer
titles.why: Core design role; implementation skill is a differentiator

titles.title: AI Product Manager
titles.why: Frames the problem and the human-agent boundary

titles.title: Visual / Brand / Graphic Designer
titles.why: Identity and voice; personal-brand projects map here

titles.title: Design Manager / Design Lead
titles.why: Leads a design team; rarely a first job

titles.title: Technical Writer / Documentation Engineer
titles.why: Explains systems; partial fit

titles.title: Creative Director / Art Director
titles.why: Sets visual and brand direction

titles.title: UX Designer
titles.why: Journeys, IA and usability

titles.title: Experience Designer
titles.why: Cross-channel experience design

titles.title: Content Designer / UX Writer
titles.why: Words in the interface, including errors and "I don't know"

titles.title: UX / User Researcher
titles.why: Observation versus inference; the usability half of the course

titles.title: AI Product Designer
titles.why: Designs human and agent roles, uncertainty and recovery states

titles.title: Learning Experience Designer
titles.why: Designed experiences for learners; the course's educational project domain

titles.title: Responsible AI Specialist
titles.why: Policy-facing trust, privacy and review work

titles.title: UI Designer
titles.why: Visual and component design

titles.title: Instructional Designer
titles.why: Courses and training; weaker on the engineering half

titles.title: Design Systems Designer
titles.why: Owns the Figma library, variables and documentation

titles.title: Motion / Interactive Designer or Developer
titles.why: Motion and interactive builds

titles.title: Digital / Creative Producer
titles.why: Coordinates creative and technical delivery

titles.title: Conversation Designer
titles.why: Voice, flows and handoff for assistants

titles.title: Interaction Designer
titles.why: States, transitions and handoffs

titles.title: Design Strategist
titles.why: Reframes problems and sets direction

titles.title: Educational Technologist
titles.why: Builds and supports learning tools

titles.title: Human Factors Engineer
titles.why: Many are hardware or defense; check the listing

titles.title: Service Designer
titles.why: People, systems and services in one journey

titles.title: Design Operations (DesignOps)
titles.why: Process, tooling and governance for design teams

titles.title: Designer Advocate / Design Advocate
titles.why: Teaches and demonstrates a design tool to designers in public

titles.title: Digital / Experience / Technology Consultant
titles.why: Consulting-channel overlap; often needs a degree plus domain

titles.title: Game UI / UX Designer or Artist
titles.why: Game interfaces; links to the CSYE 7270 course

titles.title: HCI / Human-AI Interaction Researcher
titles.why: Research-lab roles; usually need a graduate degree

titles.title: Usability / Experience QA
titles.why: Acceptance checks against design intent

titles.title: Civic Technologist / Digital Service Designer
titles.why: Public-interest services; the course's service project domain

titles.title: Information Architect
titles.why: Structure and navigation

titles.title: No-Code / Low-Code Builder
titles.why: Builds working tools without writing most of the code

tracks.name: Track 2 – Creative Engineer
tracks.who: People comfortable with both design and code. The job is designing the experience and building it.

titles.title: Design Engineer
titles.why: Design-led front end: turns Figma intent into working interfaces

titles.title: Technical Artist
titles.why: Tools and pipelines between art and engineering

titles.title: Design Systems Engineer
titles.why: Owns components, tokens and their code packages

titles.title: UI Engineer / UI Developer
titles.why: Implements interface components from a design system

titles.title: UX Engineer
titles.why: Builds and tests interaction behavior; bridges design and engineering

titles.title: Evangelist (AI, developer, product)
titles.why: Explains and demonstrates a product in public; the word is rare, most of this work is posted as Developer Advocate

titles.title: Creative Developer / Creative Engineer
titles.why: Interactive and motion-heavy web experiences

titles.title: Webflow / CMS Developer
titles.why: Site builds for clients and small organizations

titles.title: XR / Spatial Experience Designer or Developer
titles.why: Immersive experiences

titles.title: Design Technologist
titles.why: Sits between design and engineering; prototypes and system work

titles.title: Digital Experience Engineer / Developer
titles.why: Course title in the wild; often CMS or enterprise web roles

titles.title: Accessibility Engineer / Specialist
titles.why: WCAG and Section 508 checks; also the federal 508 search

titles.title: Creative Technologist
titles.why: Prototypes new experiences with code and AI; portfolio-driven

titles.title: Interaction Engineer / Developer
titles.why: Implements motion and interaction design

titles.title: Prompt Engineer
titles.why: Specifies and tests model behavior; a thin and shifting title

titles.title: Prototyper / Prototyping Engineer
titles.why: Fast working prototypes to test a design decision

tracks.name: Track 3 – Engineer
tracks.who: Strong programmers who add design and creative skill. The job is building the system, with design judgment as the differentiator.

titles.title: Solutions Engineer / Solutions Architect
titles.why: Fits a product to a customer's workflow; many are sales-side

titles.title: Full-Stack Engineer
titles.why: Broad software role; design skill is a differentiator, not the job

titles.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
titles.why: Embedded customer delivery with agents; common in AI companies

titles.title: AI Engineer / Applied AI Engineer
titles.why: Builds LLM applications; strongest overlap with the Conducting AI half

titles.title: Customer Engineer / Implementation Engineer
titles.why: Delivers a product into a customer's setting

titles.title: Front-End Engineer / Developer
titles.why: Largest market for design-to-code skill; not all roles are design-led

titles.title: Product Engineer
titles.why: Ships product features end to end; some titles are hardware

titles.title: Automation / Workflow Engineer
titles.why: Connects tools and services; some titles are test or hardware

titles.title: Developer Advocate / Developer Relations
titles.why: Teaches and demonstrates tools in public

titles.title: Growth Engineer / Marketing Technologist
titles.why: Builds and tests marketing and onboarding experiences

titles.title: AI Agent Engineer / Developer
titles.why: Bounded agent workflows, permissions, failure paths

titles.title: AI Evaluation / Evals
titles.why: Designs checks that separate observation from inference

titles.title: Web Developer / Web Engineer
titles.why: Sites and portfolio-type experiences

titles.title: Front-End / UI Platform Engineer
titles.why: Shared UI infrastructure and component platforms

titles.title: LLM / Generative AI Application Developer
titles.why: Application layer around models

titles.title: UI Programmer (games)
titles.why: Game interface implementation; links to the CSYE 7270 course

titles.title: Design Tooling / Design Infrastructure
titles.why: Tools that connect design files to code and agents
